scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:format && bun run lint:license && bun run lint:dead
scripts.lint:license: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do cmp -s LICENSE "$d/LICENSE" || { echo "LICENSE out of sync in $d (fix: bun run fix:license)"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.fix: bun run fix:code && bun run fix:license
scripts.fix:license: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do cp LICENSE "$d/LICENSE"; done
scripts.build: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do (cd "$d" && bun run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
